name: zistgah/dome: the Zistgah virtual dome as a reusable, config-driven app/lib
description: The complete zistgah.org dome experience factored into a documented, third-party-customisable library: interior hall with oculus time scrub and the CHAKRA ten-calendar strip, flight system (altitude hold by default, gravity and yaw/pitch/roll sensitivity configurable, thrust-vectored roll, 10 Hz drone-state emitter for future multi-drone presence), config-file driven worlds (per-world gravity, planetary habitats and orbital stations - the Zistgah-e-Mahtab / Zistgah-e-Bahram pattern generalised), the planet turning with the hall, built-in displays (ilm.codes-style point cloud, rotating viewer's gallery, YouTube screens), deep star shell, debug overlay, and a marked-and-counted modification discipline over the verbatim landing source. Ships with scaffold, example config, demo, and full documentation including the AAB-over-VGC engineering process practised to build it.
